raw.reasoning: The reporter is the sole payroll approver unable to authenticate to the approval portal with a named dated deadline at 14:00 today that gates staff payment, making this an access-identity issue with business-stopping impact to the payroll process.
raw.root_cause_direction: Check whether a recent password change has left a stale SSO session or refresh token blocking re-authentication to the approval portal, similar to INC-1001. Verify SSO session state and force sign-out across all sessions.
raw.draft_reply: I understand the time pressure. Sign-in loops after a password change often stem from stale SSO sessions not being invalidated by the password reset. I need to clear your SSO session from the identity provider immediately. Please sign out of the approval portal and any other systems, then try signing in again. If that does not work, let me know and we will escalate to identity access. In parallel, can you confirm whether you have tried a different browser, or cleared your browser cache and cookies for the approval portal? We need you back in before 14:00.
